en: Sepia-toned interior view of a formal meeting or club room with a long table surrounded by ornately carved high‑back wooden chairs on a carpet. At the far wall there is a large white fireplace or decorative mantel. A samovar or large metal urn sits on a side table to the left. On the right side, tall multi-pane windows with a prominent column or pilaster between them admit light. A simple ceiling lamp hangs in the center. The lower margin of the image carries a caption in German.
